subject: science
title: Plastic Cup Detective
objective: Describe the observable properties of a plastic cup and choose its safe use or handling.
introduction: Hi Maxine! 🔍 Milo found a plastic cup. Let's look closely: is it bendy or stiff, clear or colored? And how do we use it safely?

items.prompt: Which of these bends easily without breaking?
items.explanation: Rubber band bends easily, so it is flexible.
Cotton cloth soaks up water, so it absorbs water.
Stone is firm and does not bend, so it is hard.

items.prompt: What property does a plastic cup have?
items.explanation: A plastic cup is light, so that is its property.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to learn about a material?

options.text: leave it out in the rain
look at it and touch it gently

items.explanation: Looking at it and touching it gently is safe. Tasting, throwing, or hitting materials is not safe.
